segments: I went for a walk with a friend at the weekend, and we got caught in the rain without coats.
We ended up sheltering under a shop awning.
Has anything happened to you that you'd like to tell me about?
I played Minecraft with my cousin.
What were you doing in Minecraft?
We were trying to build a railway station.
Not a normal one, like one with four platforms and a storage room underneath.
He was on his Xbox and I was on the laptop.
Where were you when you were playing?
How did you start building it?
First I did the tracks, but I put the redstone in the wrong place, so the minecart stopped before the station.
It took about twenty minutes to fix it.
Then he kept putting lanterns everywhere.
What was that like for you?
I couldn't stop laughing when he put one on top of the cow.
A bit, because he used all the iron for rails and I wanted some for tools.
So you wanted to use the iron for tools, and he'd used it for rails.
What did you say to him?
I said, "Bro, that's not the plan." Then he said, "The plan has changed." What happened after that?
We went mining for more iron.
I found a cave with loads of coal and three diamonds, but that's not really part of the station.
You found three diamonds in the cave.
How did the game session end?
We saved the world and said we'd finish the station next time.
Let me check I've got it.
You and Jayden were playing from different houses, building a four-platform station.
The redstone was in the wrong place, Jayden used the iron for rails, and you both went mining before saving the world.
Yeah, and the cow lantern was the best bit.
The lantern on the cow was the funniest bit for you.
We'll leave the station there for now.
I need to show Jayden a picture of it later.

written.summary: The child told about playing Minecraft with their cousin Jayden and building a railway station. They mentioned the station had four platforms and a storage room underneath. The child and Jayden built different parts of the station and had some fun with lanterns. They also talked about finding diamonds and coal in a cave and agreeing to finish the station later.
